scope: Validation-only and rolling-validation evidence for within-user long_view ranking.

family_policies.evidence: FM+BPR improved paired seeds 0-3 by mean +0.002344 over BCE.
FM+BPR plus DeepFM improved all three rolling folds by mean +0.001123.
The apparent single-split gain won only one of three rolling folds; mean delta -0.000246.
Matched constant placebo exceeded the real sequence features, and count/adjacency variants were noise.
FM categorical and LightGBM continuous representations both reduced validation Primary.
Smoothed user-by-tab target rate reduced validation Primary.
User-by-tab, user-by-author, and their combination all reduced validation Primary.
The current strict-causal last-16 implementation was slower and below DeepFM and the champion.
LightGBM on base and statistical fields did not beat FM.

supported_findings.evidence: Across paired seeds 0-3, BPR improved mean validation Primary by 0.002344 over BCE.

supported_findings.mechanism: FM+BPR and DeepFM+BCE ensemble with DeepFM weight 0.4
supported_findings.evidence: Improved over FM+BPR in all 3 rolling folds; mean Primary delta was +0.001123.

supported_findings.mechanism: Like-only auxiliary task on multi-task DeepFM
supported_findings.evidence: Improved all 3 rolling folds over DeepFM with mean Primary delta +0.000309; official validation delta was +0.000538.

supported_findings.mechanism: Low-rank DCNv2 with 2 cross layers and rank 16
supported_findings.evidence: Improved all 3 rolling folds over DeepFM with mean Primary delta +0.000248; official validation delta was +0.000302.

rejected_findings.mechanism: Strict-past 3-day user activity and item exposure counts
rejected_findings.evidence: Improved the ensemble in only 1 of 3 rolling folds; mean incremental delta was -0.000246.

rejected_findings.mechanism: Global user/item target rates and counts
rejected_findings.evidence: Categorical FM and continuous LightGBM variants both reduced validation Primary.
Candidate pools of 2 and 4 both reduced validation Primary.

rejected_findings.mechanism: Explicit user-by-tab and user-by-author categorical crosses
rejected_findings.evidence: Each cross and their combination reduced validation Primary.
Weights 0.25, 0.50, and 0.75 did not beat pure BPR.

rejected_findings.mechanism: Censored completion ratio as the only auxiliary task
rejected_findings.evidence: Official validation delta versus DeepFM was only +0.000014, consistent with duplicating the long_view definition rather than adding information.

rejected_findings.mechanism: Capped log watch-time regression as the only auxiliary task
rejected_findings.evidence: Official validation delta versus DeepFM was only +0.000029, so the observational watch-time relationship did not translate into useful auxiliary supervision.

rejected_findings.mechanism: Pairwise BPR plus one-sided censored watch-time auxiliary supervision
rejected_findings.evidence: The controlled configuration scored 0.602523, or -0.001339 versus DeepFM+BCE and -0.001416 versus pointwise censored-watch Multi-task DeepFM. This exact pairwise configuration is rejected.

prior_video_positive and author_positive_recency appeared to add +0.000242 and +0.000236, but the matched constant-field placebo added +0.000431. Validation coverage was only 0.0304% and 0.7269%, respectively; the behavioral attribution is rejected.

rejected_findings.mechanism: Prior same-video count and immediately previous same-author indicator
rejected_findings.evidence: Official validation deltas versus FM+BPR were -0.000027 and +0.000046, respectively. The latter is below normal run-level variation and is not treated as a gain.

rejected_findings.mechanism: Adding DCNv2 to the FM+DeepFM ensemble
rejected_findings.evidence: DeepFM/DCNv2 prediction correlation was 0.9925-0.9963. DCNv2 replacement won 1/3 rolling folds (mean -0.000244); the three-model blend won 0/3 (mean -0.000272).

rejected_findings.mechanism: Replacing ensemble DeepFM with like-only multi-task DeepFM
rejected_findings.evidence: Won only 1/3 rolling folds with mean Primary delta -0.000276 despite improving DeepFM alone.

rejected_findings.mechanism: Rule gate that adds 50% DCNv2 for history_len <= 2
rejected_findings.evidence: The cold slice initially showed DCNv2 +0.009087 versus the champion, but the actual gate reduced official validation by 0.000017 and won only 2/3 rolling folds with mean +0.000012. Slice superiority alone is not ensemble evidence.

Scored 0.603369 versus 0.603862 for the controlled DeepFM and took 813.4 versus 32.7 seconds. It was 0.001344 below the champion; a predeclared 10% sequence blend was also -0.000023. Do not sweep K or blend weights for this implementation.

uncertain_findings.mechanism: Pointwise DeepFM plus one-sided censored watch-time auxiliary supervision
uncertain_findings.evidence: The controlled configuration scored 0.603939 versus 0.603862 for DeepFM+BCE, a +0.000077 delta that is too small for a scientific gain claim. Keep this exact result research-only; it does not reject every future censored-survival formulation.

uncertain_findings.mechanism: FM+BPR with a learned global_context field
uncertain_findings.evidence: Official validation delta was +0.000431 and rolling improved 3/3 folds (mean +0.000810). Across paired seeds 0-3, however, it won 3/4 with mean +0.000333 and an approximate 95% interval [-0.000427, +0.001092], so the gain is promising but not statistically confirmed.

uncertain_findings.mechanism: Using global-context FM inside the FM+DeepFM ensemble
uncertain_findings.evidence: Won all 3 rolling folds with mean delta +0.000460, but reduced official validation Primary by 0.000039. Keep as a candidate pending paired-seed checks, not the champion.

uncertain_findings.mechanism: Conditional complementarity of like-only DeepFM and DCNv2
uncertain_findings.evidence: Like-only was +0.001340 on short videos and DCNv2 was +0.009087 on cold-history rows, but both were below the champion overall and slice-derived gating did not produce a stable gain. Treat slices as hypothesis generators only.

uncertain_findings.mechanism: FM+BPR plus DeepFM ensemble under random exposure
uncertain_findings.evidence: The ensemble was +0.000750 over FM+BPR on standard exposure but -0.000155 on development-only random exposure, a relative-gain change of -0.000905. The ensemble is a standard-policy champion, while FM+BPR was more robust to exposure-policy shift.

research_policy: Prefer a new mechanism or information source over fine-grained parameter sweeps.
Do not repeat rejected mechanisms without a materially different representation or objective.
Use rolling-fold consistency when judging stability.
Never request or use official test metrics during research.
Do not add a model to an ensemble until prediction complementarity is measured.
Require constant, shuffled, and same-cardinality random controls before attributing a categorical-feature gain.
Use fixed slices to generate hypotheses, then evaluate the complete gated ranking before deciding.
next_actions: If global_context is studied further, predeclare additional paired seeds and never select the best seed.
Do not prioritize the tested censored-watch configurations over validation-supported submission candidates; reopen only for a materially different survival objective or architecture.
Integrate fixed slices, placebo verdicts, and exposure-policy robustness into the Agent's structured experiment report.
Keep the strict last-K tensors, but revisit sequence modeling only with a materially different efficient backend and architecture.
Require a matched constant-field placebo when evaluating any newly appended categorical FM feature.
Keep the original FM+BPR plus DeepFM ensemble as the current champion.
